review_summary: The code implements a custom hook and components for managing workspace and repository context in a React application. It includes functionality for loading, saving, and syncing workspace data, as well as handling user interactions for asking questions and managing attached files.

findings.title: Potential null reference in `refreshStatus`
findings.description: The `refreshStatus` function may attempt to call `latticeStatus(pk)` with an undefined `pk` if both `key` and `projectKey` are undefined, leading to a runtime error.
findings.suggestion: Ensure that `pk` is defined before calling `latticeStatus(pk)`.
findings.fixed_code:
const pk = key || projectKey;
if (!pk) return;

findings.title: Redundant state updates in `loadBlueprintPrompt`
findings.description: The `loadBlueprintPrompt` function updates the state with `prompt` and also saves it to context. If the API call fails, it returns an empty string, which could be misleading.
findings.suggestion: Consider handling the error case more explicitly and avoid updating state with an empty string.

findings.title: Tight coupling between components and context
findings.description: The `AskMode` component is tightly coupled with the `useWorkspaceRepoContext` hook, making it difficult to reuse or test independently. Consider abstracting the context logic to improve separation of concerns.
findings.code_snippet: const { activeRepoId, projectKey, blueprintPrompt, loadSavedBlueprint } = useWorkspaceRepoContext();
findings.suggestion: Refactor the context logic into a separate component or utility to enhance modularity.
